settings.heading: Forum-wide
settings.dark_help: Same as light is how Flarum draws tags. Adjust automatically keeps each tag's hue but softens it so it sits well on a dark page. A tag can choose for itself in its Edit Tag dialog.
settings.auto_text_help: Picks black or white text for each tag color by its real contrast (WCAG), where Flarum's own pick can leave text too faint on mid-tone colors like red, green and blue. A tag's own text color always wins.

palette.heading: Color every tag
palette.intro: Pick a starting color and a scheme. Nothing is saved until you press Apply, and Apply can be undone.
palette.shade_children: Shade child tags from their parent
palette.only_uncolored: Only tags with no color yet
palette.apply: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to apply} one {Apply to # tag} other {Apply to # tags}}
palette.apply_help: Locked tags keep their colors. Recolored tags go back to automatic text colors. Recent changes can be undone, newest first.
palette.undo: {count, plural, one {Undo last change (# tag, {time})} other {Undo last change (# tags, {time})}}
palette.applied: {count, plural, one {# tag recolored.} other {# tags recolored.}}

preview.summary: {changed, plural, one {# tag changes} other {# tags change}}, {locked} locked.
preview.summary_low: {count, plural, one {# label is} other {# labels are}} under 4.5:1 contrast; turn on Readable tag text, or give those tags their own text color.

edit_tag.lock_help: Color every tag skips a locked tag.
edit_tag.preview_needs_color: Pick a color to see a preview.
edit_tag.low_contrast: The text reaches only {ratio}:1 contrast; 4.5:1 is the minimum for readable text.
edit_tag.fix_contrast: Adjust the color to fix it

api.unknown_tag: One of the tags no longer exists. Reload the page and try again.
api.locked_tag: One of the tags is locked. Reload the page and try again.
api.bad_color: Every color must be a six-digit hex color like #3a7bd5.
api.undo_newest_first: Only the newest change can be undone. Undo the newer one first.
api.nothing_to_apply: There are no tag colors to apply.
api.too_many: Livery recolors up to {max} tags in one change. Lock some tags, or turn on Only tags with no color yet, and apply again.
api.busy: Another color change is being saved. Try again in a moment.
